summary: Revenue rose 3.2% to $97.8M in 2025. Operating income rose 6.0× to $5.0M, a 5.1% margin.
Net income rose 3.2× to $7.1M, or $0.79 per share. Operating cash flow was $18.9M and free cash flow $18.8M, versus $21.0M; Westwood returned $5.4M through dividends.
sources: Westwood Holdings Group, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
